note: Answerable questions point at one expected page and a verbatim passage. Unanswerable questions are about things the policy does not state; they are not scored for retrieval.

questions.question: My claim was denied because I was in hospital for only 6 hours for dialysis. Are short stays covered?
questions.expected_passage: covered irrespective of the duration of the stay in hospital

questions.question: How long do I have to wait before surgery for a pre-existing condition gets paid?
questions.expected_passage: payable only after 36 months of continuous coverage

questions.question: The insurer cut my whole bill because I took a deluxe room. Is that allowed?
questions.expected_passage: reduced in the same proportion as the room rent bears to the permitted limit

questions.question: What is the daily cap on a normal private room?
questions.expected_passage: up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day

questions.question: I am 64 and was told to pay part of every claim myself. Where does that come from?
questions.expected_passage: co-payment of 10% applies to every claim

questions.question: Does the policy pay for my nose job after a road accident?
questions.expected_passage: unless it is needed because of an accident

questions.question: They refused the admission kit and toiletries charges on my bill. Is that correct?
questions.expected_passage: admission kits, toiletries and service charges

questions.question: How soon must I tell the insurer after an emergency admission?
questions.expected_passage: within 24 hours of admission

questions.question: How many days after discharge can I send my reimbursement papers?
questions.expected_passage: within 15 days of discharge

questions.question: My rejection letter does not mention any policy clause. Does it have to?
questions.expected_passage: must name the clause of this policy on which we rely

questions.question: How long does the insurer have to decide on my claim?
questions.expected_passage: within 30 days of receiving the last necessary document

questions.question: Will I get interest if the insurer pays late?
questions.expected_passage: we pay interest on the amount

questions.question: I moved here from another insurer last year. Do my waiting periods start again?
questions.expected_passage: the waiting period already served is credited

questions.question: I forgot to renew for six weeks. Do I lose the credit for waiting periods?
questions.expected_passage: A break in cover of more than 30 days

questions.question: After how many years can the insurer no longer reject my claim for not disclosing an illness?
questions.expected_passage: After 60 continuous months of coverage

questions.question: Is my cataract operation limited to a certain amount?
questions.expected_passage: Rs. 40,000 per eye

questions.question: What is the waiting period for hernia surgery?
questions.expected_passage: covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage

questions.question: I broke my leg in the first month after buying the policy. Does the initial waiting period apply?
questions.expected_passage: do not apply to hospitalisation caused by an accidental injury

questions.question: How much will the policy pay for an ambulance?
questions.expected_passage: up to Rs. 2,000 per hospitalisation

questions.question: Are tests done in the weeks before my admission covered?
questions.expected_passage: during the 30 days immediately before the date of admission

questions.question: Is treatment taken at home covered?
questions.expected_passage: for more than 3 consecutive days

questions.question: Where can I complain if the insurer does not resolve my complaint?
questions.expected_passage: Insurance Ombudsman

questions.question: How fast must the grievance officer reply to my complaint?
questions.expected_passage: acknowledge it within 3 working days

questions.question: Can the insurer ask me for extra documents after I submit the claim?
questions.expected_passage: within 7 days of receiving the claim

questions.question: Is a weight-loss operation covered?
questions.expected_passage: body mass index is above 40

questions.question: The hospital admitted me only for tests. Why was the claim refused?
questions.expected_passage: only for diagnostic tests or evaluation

questions.question: What counts as a pre-existing disease?
questions.expected_passage: within 36 months before the first policy start date

questions.question: Does an intensive care stay have its own daily cap?
questions.expected_passage: intensive care unit charges are limited to 2%

questions.question: Can the insurer refuse to renew my policy because I made a claim?
questions.expected_passage: will not refuse renewal only because a claim was made

questions.question: Does my sum insured grow if I do not make a claim?
questions.expected_passage: increases by 5% for each claim-free year
